[process narration moved out of reading 2026-09-02] This Vantage Data Centers facility is registered in this OSM-derived registry as a second, closely spaced way also named Vantage TX12, about 100 meters from osm:way/1533349844. It is treated as sharing the same Texas Research Park campus address and identity as that row rather than a distinct building. Per trade press (DataCenterDynamics) and the DataCenterMap aggregator, the TX12 building is at 17420 Omicron Drive, San Antonio, TX, with a filed capacity of 96 MW and 432,800 square feet, targeted for around August 2027 completion and so not confirmed operational. That figure is recorded in full on the paired row, osm:way/1533349844, and is not repeated into this rows planned_capacity or critical_it_mw fields, to avoid a single reported building capacity being counted twice across two registry rows. A prior note on this row associated it with Frontier, a Vantage mega-campus announced August 2025. This is corrected here, Vantages own August 2025 press release (tier-1 operator source, https://vantage-dc.com/news/vantage-data-centers-unveils-plans-for-frontier-a-25b-mega-campus-in-texas-to-meet-unprecedented-ai-demand/) states Frontier is a 1,200 acre, 1.4 GW, 25 billion dollar, ten building campus in Shackelford County, Texas, near Albany, roughly 300 miles from San Antonio and Bexar County. Frontier is not the San Antonio area campus this row belongs to, it is a separate, later, and much larger project elsewhere in Texas.
